name: mom_1m
description: Excess log return of month t (short-term reversal / momentum). For hy_credit before 2007-04 (smoothed fund NAV) part of any signal is stale pricing.

name: mom_3m
description: Sum of excess log returns over months t-2..t.

name: mom_6m
description: Sum of excess log returns over months t-5..t.

name: mom_12m
description: Sum of excess log returns over months t-11..t.

name: mom_12_1
description: 12-minus-1 momentum: sum of excess log returns over months t-11..t-1 (skips month t).

name: lt_rev_60_12
description: Long-term reversal: sum of excess log returns over months t-59..t-12 (48 months).

name: mom_1m_vs
description: mom_1m divided by the asset's trailing monthly volatility (36m, min 24).

name: mom_3m_vs
description: mom_3m / (trailing monthly vol x sqrt(3)): a t-statistic-like 3-month trend.

name: mom_12_1_vs
description: mom_12_1 / (trailing monthly vol x sqrt(11)): volatility-scaled time-series momentum, comparable across assets.

name: trend_ma10
description: Log of the excess-return index over its 10-month simple moving average (months t-9..t).

name: trend_ma3_12
description: Log ratio of the 3-month to the 12-month moving average of the excess-return index.

name: dd_12m
description: Drawdown of the excess-return index from its maximum over the last 12 months (log, <= 0).

name: dd_max
description: Drawdown of the excess-return index from its running maximum since the asset's history began (log, <= 0); needs 12 months.

name: vol_m_12m
description: Annualised sd of monthly excess log returns over months t-11..t.

name: vol_m_36m
description: Annualised sd of monthly excess log returns over months t-35..t (min 24). Understated in smoothed fund-NAV eras (e.g. hy_credit before 2007-04).

name: vol_d_1m
description: Annualised realised vol from daily log returns in month t (sqrt(252 x mean r^2), min 10 days). NaN where no daily series exists (see segments.csv). The daily source changes at segment boundaries (e.g. hy_credit fund NAV to HYG at 2007-04).

name: vol_d_3m
description: Annualised realised vol from daily log returns over months t-2..t (min 40 days); same coverage caveats as vol_d_1m.

name: vol_d_ratio
description: Log of 1-month over 12-month daily realised vol (vol regime shift; self-normalised so comparable across assets and daily sources).

name: beta_eq_36m
description: Rolling 36-month (min 24) beta of the asset's monthly excess return on US large-cap equity excess return.

name: xs_rank_mom_12_1_vs
description: Cross-sectional percentile rank (0..1) of mom_12_1_vs among assets with a value on date t (needs >= 4 assets).

name: xs_rank_mom_3m_vs
description: Cross-sectional percentile rank (0..1) of mom_3m_vs among assets with a value on date t (needs >= 4 assets).

name: xs_rank_lt_rev
description: Cross-sectional percentile rank of vol-scaled long-term reversal (lt_rev_60_12 / vol_m_36m).

name: g_eq_mom_12_1
description: US large-cap equity 12-minus-1 momentum (global equity trend state).

name: g_bond_mom_12_1
description: Intermediate (7-10y) Treasury 12-minus-1 momentum (global rates trend state).

name: g_cmdty_mom_12_1
description: Commodity 12-minus-1 momentum (inflation / growth state).

name: g_eq_vol_d_1m
description: US large-cap equity realised vol from daily returns in month t (annualised).

name: g_eq_dd_max
description: US large-cap equity drawdown from its running maximum (excess-return index).

name: g_sb_corr_d_3m
description: Correlation of daily US large-cap equity and intermediate (7-10y) Treasury returns over months t-2..t (min 40 joint days).

name: g_sb_corr_m_36m
description: Correlation of monthly US large-cap equity and intermediate (7-10y) Treasury excess returns over 36 months (min 24).

name: g_trend_breadth
description: Share of assets with positive 12-minus-1 momentum on date t (NaN when fewer than 5 assets have a value).

name: carry
description: Own carry slot, % p.a. over cash (what the asset earns if prices do not move). us_large: S&P 500 dividend yield (%) minus 3m T-bill; intl_dev: Developed ex-US trailing dividend yield (%) minus 3m T-bill; ends 2025-12 with the French file; ust_int: 7y GSW zero yield minus 3m T-bill; ust_long: 10y GSW zero yield minus 3m T-bill (10y used throughout for a consistent series; the GSW 20y starts only 1981-07, the asset is a 20-30y ladder); tips: 7y real zero yield (interp. 5y/10y GSW TIPS) + trailing 12m CPI inflation (expected index accrual) minus 3m T-bill; ig_credit: Average of Moody's Aaa and Baa seasoned long corporate yields (monthly averages) minus 3m T-bill; gold: Minus the 3m T-bill: gold pays no income, so its carry over cash (as in the gold futures basis, ignoring lease rates) is -r_f; commodities: trailing 12-month mean of the WTI crude futures roll yield (12 x ln F1/F2, %), a single-commodity proxy for the basket's basis; already an excess-of-cash carry; ends 2024-04. NaN for us_small, em, hy_credit, reits (no yield or basis series in the panel).

name: value
description: Own valuation slot, oriented so high = cheap, standardised against the series' own past (expanding, min 60 months). us_large: expanding z of log(1/CAPE); intl_dev: expanding z of log developed ex-US book-to-market; ends 2025-12; ust_int: expanding z of the 7y real yield (7y zero minus trailing 12m CPI inflation); ust_long: expanding z of the 10y real yield (10y zero minus trailing 12m CPI inflation); tips: expanding z of the 7y TIPS real yield (min 60 months, so from 2004); ig_credit: expanding z of the Baa minus 10y Treasury spread; gold: minus the expanding z of the log real gold price (monthly average price / CPI), using free-market history from 1975 only. NaN for us_small, em, hy_credit, reits, commodities (no credible valuation series; commodity value is left to lt_rev_60_12).

name: g_tbill
description: 3-month T-bill rate, % (level of the cash rate).

name: g_tbill_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in the 3m T-bill rate, pp (policy cycle).

name: g_real_tbill
description: 3m T-bill minus trailing 12m CPI inflation, % (real short rate / monetary stance).

name: g_term_spread
description: 10y CMT minus 3m T-bill, pp (yield-curve slope).

name: g_term_spread_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in the 10y-3m term spread, pp.

name: g_default_spread
description: Moody's Baa minus Aaa yield, pp (monthly averages).

name: g_default_spread_z
description: Expanding z of the Baa-Aaa default spread.

name: g_gz_spread
description: Gilchrist-Zakrajsek corporate bond credit spread, pp (all grades).

name: g_gz_spread_chg_3m
description: 3-month change in the GZ credit spread, pp (credit momentum).

name: g_us_cape_ey_z
description: Expanding z of log(1/CAPE): US equity valuation as a global risk-appetite state.

name: g_us_dy_z
description: Expanding z of the log S&P 500 dividend yield.

name: g_eq_bond_gap
description: Excess CAPE yield: 100/CAPE minus the 10y real yield (10y zero minus trailing CPI inflation), pp.

name: g_acm_tp_10y
description: ACM 10-year Treasury term premium, %. Hindsight: full-sample affine model.

name: g_breakeven_10y
description: 10y zero breakeven inflation (GSW), % (from 1999).

name: g_breakeven_10y_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in 10y breakeven inflation, pp.

name: cpi_yoy
description: Headline CPI 12-month log change, % (as first published).

name: cpi_yoy_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in headline CPI inflation, pp (inflation momentum).

name: core_cpi_yoy
description: Core CPI 12-month log change, %.

name: infl_exp_1y
description: Michigan median 1-year inflation expectation, % (from 1978).

name: ip_yoy
description: Industrial production 12-month log change, % (real-time vintage).

name: payrolls_yoy
description: Nonfarm payrolls 12-month log change, % (real-time vintage).

name: payrolls_3m
description: Nonfarm payrolls 3-month log change, annualised % (real-time vintage).

name: unemp_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in the unemployment rate, pp (each end from the vintage in force at its date).

name: unemp_sahm
description: Sahm-type gap: 3-month average unemployment rate minus its minimum over the prior 12 months, pp.

name: hours_mfg_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in average weekly manufacturing hours (leading indicator).

name: housing_starts_yoy
description: Housing starts 12-month log change, %.

name: permits_yoy
description: Building permits 12-month log change, %.

name: retail_sales_yoy
description: Nominal retail sales 12-month log change, % (real-time vintage).

name: capacity_util_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in capacity utilisation, pp.

name: cfnai_ma3
description: 3-month average of the Chicago Fed National Activity Index. Hindsight: full-sample PCA weights.

name: claims_yoy
description: Initial jobless claims (4-week average) 12-month log change, %.

name: real_m2_yoy
description: M2 growth minus CPI inflation (12-month log changes), % (from 1980).

name: ci_loans_yoy
description: C&I bank loans 12-month log change, % (contains reclassification breaks).

name: consumer_credit_yoy
description: Consumer credit 12-month log change, %.

name: fed_funds_chg_12m
description: 12-month change in the effective fed funds rate, pp.

name: fed_funds_chg_3m
description: 3-month change in the effective fed funds rate, pp.

name: nfci
description: Chicago Fed NFCI level (positive = tighter than average). Hindsight: full-sample factor model.

name: nfci_chg_3m
description: 3-month change in NFCI. Hindsight: full-sample factor model.

name: usd_chg_3m
description: Trade-weighted US dollar 3-month log change, %.

name: usd_chg_12m
description: Trade-weighted US dollar 12-month log change, %.

name: oil_yoy
description: WTI spot (monthly average) 12-month log change, %.

name: log_vix
description: Log VIX at month end (from 1990).

name: vix_rel_12m
description: Log VIX minus its trailing 12-month mean (fear shock).

name: vrp
description: Variance risk premium: VIX^2/12 minus the realised variance of daily US large-cap equity (us_large: French Hi-30, SPY from 1993-02) log returns in month t, monthly %^2. Computed here rather than taken from the predictor 'vrp', which ends 2025-12.

name: umich_sentiment_z
description: Expanding z of Michigan consumer sentiment.

name: bw_sentiment
description: Baker-Wurgler orthogonalised investor sentiment; ends 2018-12. Hindsight: full-sample PCA and regressions.

name: bw_sentiment_pit
description: Point-in-time Baker-Wurgler-style sentiment: mean of expanding z-scores of the raw components (minus closed-end discount, log1p IPO count, IPO first-day return, equity share, minus dividend premium); needs 4 of 5; ends 2018-12.

name: net_equity_issuance
description: Goyal-Welch net equity expansion (12m net issues / market cap); ends 2025-12.

name: margin_debt_yoy
description: FINRA margin debt 12-month log change, % (leverage-driven sentiment; from 1998).

name: excess_bond_premium
description: Gilchrist-Zakrajsek excess bond premium, pp. Hindsight: full-sample regression residual.

name: epu_z
description: Expanding z of the log news-based economic policy uncertainty index.

name: gpr_shock
description: Log historical geopolitical risk index minus its trailing 12-month mean.
